BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
ACT III OF 1998
An Act to amend the Balochistan Health Foundation
Act, 1994
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th November, 1998]
No. PAB/LEGIS.V(8)/97, dated 14‑11‑1998.‑‑The
Balochistan Health Foundation (Amendment) Act, 1998 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly on 24th October, 1998 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan
Health Foundation (Amendment) Act, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

Amendment of section 2 of Act I of 1994

BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
ACT III OF 1998
An Act to amend the Balochistan Health Foundation
Act, 1994
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th November, 1998]
No. PAB/LEGIS.V(8)/97, dated 14‑11‑1998.‑‑The
Balochistan Health Foundation (Amendment) Act, 1998 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly on 24th October, 1998 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act I of 1994.‑‑In the Balochistan Health Foundation Act, 1994,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 2,
(a) for clause (q), the following
shall be substituted
"(q) 'Rural areas' means
areas declared by Government to be rural areas;
(b) after clause (q), the
following new clauses shall be added:
"(r) 'Urban Areas' means
areas declared by Government to be urban areas
(s) 'Vice‑Chairman' means
the Vice‑Chairman of the Foundation"

3. Amendment of section 3 of
Act I of 1994.‑‑In the said Act, after the proviso of
subsection (1) of section 5, the following new subsection, shall be added:‑‑
"(IA) The
Vice‑Chairman shall be designated amongst the members of the Board, who
shall carry out all the duties and functions of the Chairman in his
absence."

Amendment of section 13 of Act I of 1994

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998

[Gazette of

No. PAB/LEGIS.V(8)/97, dated 14‑11‑1998.‑‑The
Balochistan Health Foundation (Amendment) Act, 1998 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly on 24th October, 1998 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
4. Amendment of section 13 of
Act I of 1994.‑‑In the said Act, for clause (b), (c), (d) and
(e) of subsection (2) of section 13; the following shall be substituted:
'(b) Give grants, to non profit
making Health Institutions in rural and urban areas for purchase of Medicines,
Land, Construction of Building, Purchase of Equipments, Furniture etc. not
exceeding 1/3rd of total cost as grant, and 1/3rd as a Loan, while remaining
cost shall be borne by the Organisation/Institutions;
Provided that grant‑in‑aid
is not applied for the amount of the Loan applied/offered, can be up to 50% of
the proposed Project/Scheme.
(c) Give loans to such Health
Institutions working on commercial basis in rural and urban areas to the extent
of 50 % of the total cost, whereas the remaining 50 % of the cost shall be
borne by the Institution itself.
(d) Provide loans to Doctors for
opening of Clinics in Rural and Urban Areas of the Province.
(e) Assist the Commercial/Non‑Commercial
Institutions and Doctors working in the Rural and Urban Areas. in getting loans
from Scheduled Banks and Financial Institutions.
